newsitem.title: USA: Caribiner closes purchase of Total Audio.
newsitem.headline: Caribiner closes purchase of Total Audio.

text.p: Caribiner International Inc said it had completed its acquisition of Total Audio Visual Services from GE Capital Services for about $27 million in cash.
As a result of the transaction, Caribiner has entered a five-year alliance with GE Capital Technology Management Services to develop business opportunities for their respective client bases, it said.
Caribiner organizes meetings, events and training programs for businesses, while GE Capital offers financial services and Total Audio provides audio-visual equipment rentals and staging services.
